The '''Selruvian biome''' was the name of sector 8022 of the artificial world designated [[Iokath]]. In [[3630 BBY]], [[ARIES]] trapped the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] leadership on Iokath, placing [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] and [[Torian Cadera]] inside the Selruvian biome.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selruvian biome appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' "Chapter IV: Where Dreams Die".
